content:
Evidence from the datasheet: specs are given for **FTLF1323P1XTR** (Sections II–VI). Note 5 and the Applications section pair **OC-3 IR-1 / STM S-1.1** and **OC-3 SR / STM I-1** at OC-3 (155 Mb/s); **Fast Ethernet** aligns with 125 Mb/s and RSENS2. Table IV uses **λ 1261–1360 nm** (Tx) for all; RSENS1/RSENS2 share **−28 to −8 dBm** (use **−28** as the sensitivity value). **P1BTR / P1WTR / P1xTR / P1xTL** have no separate optical/electrical tables in the excerpt, so modes are not split by those part numbers without guessing.
